'''Chosen''' was a title among the most devoted of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Cult of Ki Sazen|cult]] that worshipped the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]]. Among the Chosen were the Niktos [[Chevuk]], [[Bo'kesh]] and [[Fhentar]].
